supplemental_fixes.description: Resolve OAuth .env beside the executable before working-directory fallbacks so autostart and file-association launches use the installed client configuration; regression tests cover unrelated/missing working directories and existing overrides.

Publish ordered account health recovery after successful sync passes; retain full-reconcile failures across Inbox-only success; retry failed full reconciliation with independent capped backoff and make manual sync a full pass. Add double-BYE recovery and account-status regressions.
supplemental_fixes.validation_note: Double-BYE fixture counts actual SELECT failures rather than platform-dependent accepted TCP connections; recovery assertions verify subsequent SELECT completion.
